case_title: Defective Mobile Phone - Missing Purchase Invoice

expected_checklist.reason: The purchase invoice has not been provided.
The consumer has submitted a notice describing the defect.

additional_evidence_concerns.reason: Payment confirmation has not been provided.
The available case information does not establish whether a complete inspection report exists.

expected_review.reason: The purchase invoice is missing and payment confirmation is unavailable. The service inspection evidence also requires clarification.

expected_outcome.recommended_action: Request the purchase invoice or alternative proof of purchase and payment confirmation. Clarify the service inspection report.

testing_notes: The system should identify the missing purchase invoice.
The system should not mark the warranty, defect notice or merchant reply as missing.
The system should distinguish standard checklist documents from additional supporting evidence.
The system should not automatically reject the consumer's complaint.
